import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect loaded data (optional, can be commented out)
    # print(df_source0.head())
    # print(df_source1.head())
    
    # Join Source0 and Source1 on PLAYER == Player
    # This will add the '2017-18' column from source0 to source1 rows matched by player name
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source1, df_source0, left_on='Player', right_on='PLAYER', how='inner')
    
    # After merge, reorder and rename columns to match target schema:
    # Target Schema: ['PLAYER': string, '2017-18': integer, '#': integer, 'Player': string, 'Team': string, 'GP': integer, 'MPG': float, 'FGM': float, 'FGA': float, 'FG%': float, '3PM': float, '3PA': float, '3P%': float, 'FTM': float, 'FTA': float, 'FT%': float, 'TOV': float, 'PF': float, 'ORB': float, 'DRB': float, 'RPG': float, 'APG': float, 'SPG': float, 'BPG': float, 'PPG': float]
    
    # PLAYER column: from source0 'PLAYER' (same as 'Player' but from source0)
    # '2017-18' from source0
    # The rest from source1
    
    # Select and reorder columns accordingly
    target_columns = [
        'PLAYER',    # from source0 PLAYER
        '2017-18',   # from source0 2017-18
        '#',         # from source1
        'Player',    # from source1
        'Team',      # from source1
        'GP',        # from source1
        'MPG',       # from source1
        'FGM',       # from source1
        'FGA',       # from source1
        'FG%',       # from source1
        '3PM',       # from source1
        '3PA',       # from source1
        '3P%',       # from source1
        'FTM',       # from source1
        'FTA',       # from source1
        'FT%',       # from source1
        'TOV',       # from source1
        'PF',        # from source1
        'ORB',       # from source1
        'DRB',       # from source1
        'RPG',       # from source1
        'APG',       # from source1
        'SPG',       # from source1
        'BPG',       # from source1
        'PPG'        # from source1
    ]
    
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns].copy()
    
    # Ensure correct dtypes according to target schema:
    # PLAYER: string
    df_target['PLAYER'] = df_target['PLAYER'].astype(str)
    # 2017-18: integer
    df_target['2017-18'] = df_target['2017-18'].astype(int)
    # #: integer
    df_target['#'] = df_target['#'].astype(int)
    # Player: string
    df_target['Player'] = df_target['Player'].astype(str)
    # Team: string
    df_target['Team'] = df_target['Team'].astype(str)
    # GP: integer
    df_target['GP'] = df_target['GP'].astype(int)
    # MPG: float
    df_target['MPG'] = df_target['MPG'].astype(float)
    # FGM: float
    df_target['FGM'] = df_target['FGM'].astype(float)
    # FGA: float
    df_target['FGA'] = df_target['FGA'].astype(float)
    # FG%: float
    df_target['FG%'] = df_target['FG%'].astype(float)
    # 3PM: float
    df_target['3PM'] = df_target['3PM'].astype(float)
    # 3PA: float
    df_target['3PA'] = df_target['3PA'].astype(float)
    # 3P%: float
    df_target['3P%'] = df_target['3P%'].astype(float)
    # FTM: float
    df_target['FTM'] = df_target['FTM'].astype(float)
    # FTA: float
    df_target['FTA'] = df_target['FTA'].astype(float)
    # FT%: float
    df_target['FT%'] = df_target['FT%'].astype(float)
    # TOV: float
    df_target['TOV'] = df_target['TOV'].astype(float)
    # PF: float
    df_target['PF'] = df_target['PF'].astype(float)
    # ORB: float
    df_target['ORB'] = df_target['ORB'].astype(float)
    # DRB: float
    df_target['DRB'] = df_target['DRB'].astype(float)
    # RPG: float
    df_target['RPG'] = df_target['RPG'].astype(float)
    # APG: float
    df_target['APG'] = df_target['APG'].astype(float)
    # SPG: float
    df_target['SPG'] = df_target['SPG'].astype(float)
    # BPG: float
    df_target['BPG'] = df_target['BPG'].astype(float)
    # PPG: float
    df_target['PPG'] = df_target['PPG'].astype(float)
    
    # Write the result to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_14/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

    main()
